rules: The state transfers to every gmina, powiat and voivodeship its share in personal income tax (PIT), its share in corporate income tax (CIT) and the general subsidy, in the amounts the Minister of Finance set for the year.

Wealth correction (korekta z tytułu zamożności, article 32 of the act on the revenue of local government units of 2024-10-01): a local government whose income per adjusted resident is above 120% of the figure for its kind receives less, first from its general subsidy, then from its tax shares. The shares, the subsidy and the total shown already include the cut; the correction is shown to say how much less, not to be subtracted again.
A city with powiat rights is one local government that covers both its gmina and its powiat.
Each moving dot stands for the same amount of money on every flow.
